name: Duradel
notes: Replaced by Kuradal, his daughter, after the events of While Guthix Sleeps; Kuradal has the same requirements and assigns the identical task list.
The only master with a Slayer level requirement; the combat level requirement (but not Slayer 50) can be bypassed by showing a Slayer cape.
Shilo Village quest completion is needed to enter Shilo Village; Karamja gloves 4 teleport directly to him.
Assigns very similar tasks to Nieve but in slightly higher quantities.
Reached via the ladder in the fishing shop south of the river - he cannot be accessed from the north bank.
